questions.solution_md:
Proporsiyaning asosiy xossasi: chetki hadlar ko'paytmasi o'rta hadlar ko'paytmasiga teng.

$$x\cdot 2=6\cdot 4\ \Rightarrow\ x=\frac{24}{2}=12$$
questions.mistake_note_md: Tipik xato: Proporsiyada noma'lum hadni topishda ko'paytirish va bo'lishni adashtirish (teskari nisbat olish).

ru.solution_md:
Основное свойство пропорции: произведение крайних членов равно произведению средних.

$$x\cdot 2=6\cdot 4\ \Rightarrow\ x=\frac{24}{2}=12$$
ru.mistake_note_md: Типичная ошибка: Путать умножение и деление при нахождении неизвестного члена (брать обратное отношение).

kaa.solution_md:
Proporciyanıń tiykarǵı qásiyeti: shetki aǵzalar kóbeymesi ortaǵı aǵzalar kóbeymesine teń.

$$x\cdot 2=6\cdot 4\ \Rightarrow\ x=\frac{24}{2}=12$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Proporciyada belgisiz aǵzanı tabıwda kóbeytiw menen bóliwdi shatastırıw (teskeri qatnas alıw).

en.solution_md:
Basic property of a proportion: the product of the extremes equals the product of the means.

$$x\cdot 2=6\cdot 4\ \Rightarrow\ x=\frac{24}{2}=12$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Mixing up multiplication and division when finding the unknown term (using the inverse ratio).

questions.mistake_note_md: Tipik xato: Foizni 100 ga bo'lishni unutish yoki sonni foizga bo'lib yuborish.

ru.mistake_note_md: Типичная ошибка: Забыть разделить проценты на 100 или разделить число на проценты.

kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Procentti 100 ge bóliwdi umıtıw yamasa sandı procentke bólip jiberiw.

en.solution_md:
Convert the percent to a fraction: $p\%=\dfrac{p}{100}$.

$$160\cdot\frac{75}{100}=120$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Forgetting to divide the percent by 100, or dividing the number by the percent.

questions.solution_md:
Asosiy logarifmik ayniyat: $a^{\log_a x}=x$. Darajani ko'paytuvchilarga ajratamiz:

$$3^{\log_{3} 5+1}=\left(3^{\log_{3} 5}\right)^{1}\cdot 3^{1}=5^{1}\cdot 3=15$$
questions.mistake_note_md: Tipik xato: Ko'rsatkichdagi yig'indini daraja ko'paytmasi o'rniga yig'indi sifatida qoldirish: $a^{x+c}=a^x\cdot a^c$.

ru.solution_md:
Основное логарифмическое тождество: $a^{\log_a x}=x$. Разложим степень на множители:

$$3^{\log_{3} 5+1}=\left(3^{\log_{3} 5}\right)^{1}\cdot 3^{1}=5^{1}\cdot 3=15$$
ru.mistake_note_md: Типичная ошибка: Не разложить показатель-сумму в произведение: $a^{x+c}=a^x\cdot a^c$.

kaa.solution_md:
Tiykarǵı logarifmlik ayniyat: $a^{\log_a x}=x$. Dárejeni kóbeytiwshilerge ajıratamız:

$$3^{\log_{3} 5+1}=\left(3^{\log_{3} 5}\right)^{1}\cdot 3^{1}=5^{1}\cdot 3=15$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Kórsetkishtegi qosındını dáreje kóbeymesi ornına qosındı retinde qaldırıw: $a^{x+c}=a^x\cdot a^c$.

en.solution_md:
Basic logarithmic identity: $a^{\log_a x}=x$. Split the power into factors:

$$3^{\log_{3} 5+1}=\left(3^{\log_{3} 5}\right)^{1}\cdot 3^{1}=5^{1}\cdot 3=15$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Not splitting a sum in the exponent into a product: $a^{x+c}=a^x\cdot a^c$.

questions.stem_md: Kvadrat tenglama berilgan: $x^{2} + 4x + 3 = 0$. Uning ildizlari $x_1$ va $x_2$.

a.hint: Javobni butun son, oddiy kasr (masalan 3/4) yoki o'nli kasr (masalan 0.75) ko'rinishida yozing.

b.hint: Javobni butun son, oddiy kasr (masalan 3/4) yoki o'nli kasr (masalan 0.75) ko'rinishida yozing.

questions.solution_md:
Diskriminant: $D = 16 - 4\cdot 1\cdot 3 = 4$, $\sqrt{D} = 2$.

Ildizlar: $x_{1,2} = \frac{-4 \pm 2}{2}$, ya'ni $x_1 = -3$, $x_2 = -1$. Katta ildiz $-1$.

Kvadratlar yig'indisi: $x_1^2 + x_2^2 = 10$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Diskriminantni hisoblashda yoki kasr ildizni kvadratga ko'tarishda (faqat suratni kvadratga oshirib, maxrajni unutish) xato qilish.

ru.stem_md: Дано квадратное уравнение $x^{2} + 4x + 3 = 0$. Его корни — $x_1$ и $x_2$.

a.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом, обыкновенной дробью (например, 3/4) или десятичной дробью (например, 0.75).

b.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом, обыкновенной дробью (например, 3/4) или десятичной дробью (например, 0.75).

ru.solution_md:
Дискриминант: $D = 16 - 4\cdot 1\cdot 3 = 4$, $\sqrt{D} = 2$.

Корни: $x_{1,2} = \frac{-4 \pm 2}{2}$, то есть $x_1 = -3$, $x_2 = -1$. Больший корень равен $-1$.

Сумма квадратов: $x_1^2 + x_2^2 = 10$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Ошибки при вычислении дискриминанта или при возведении дробного корня в квадрат (возводят в квадрат только числитель).

a.hint: Juwaptı pútin san, ápiwayı bólshek (mısalı 3/4) yamasa onlıq bólshek (mısalı 0.75) kórinisinde jazıń.

b.hint: Juwaptı pútin san, ápiwayı bólshek (mısalı 3/4) yamasa onlıq bólshek (mısalı 0.75) kórinisinde jazıń.

kaa.solution_md:
Diskriminant: $D = 16 - 4\cdot 1\cdot 3 = 4$, $\sqrt{D} = 2$.

Túbirler: $x_{1,2} = \frac{-4 \pm 2}{2}$, yaǵnıy $x_1 = -3$, $x_2 = -1$. Úlken túbir $-1$.

Kvadratlar qosındısı: $x_1^2 + x_2^2 = 10$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Diskriminantti esaplawda yamasa bólshek túbirdi kvadratqa kóteriwde (tek alımdı kvadratqa kóterip, bólimdi umıtıw) qátelesiw.

en.stem_md: The quadratic equation $x^{2} + 4x + 3 = 0$ is given. Its roots are $x_1$ and $x_2$.

a.prompt_md: Find the larger root of the equation.
a.hint: Write the answer as an integer, a common fraction (e.g. 3/4) or a decimal (e.g. 0.75).

b.hint: Write the answer as an integer, a common fraction (e.g. 3/4) or a decimal (e.g. 0.75).

en.solution_md:
Discriminant: $D = 16 - 4\cdot 1\cdot 3 = 4$, $\sqrt{D} = 2$.

Roots: $x_{1,2} = \frac{-4 \pm 2}{2}$, that is $x_1 = -3$, $x_2 = -1$. The larger root is $-1$.

Sum of squares: $x_1^2 + x_2^2 = 10$.
en.mistake_note_md: Errors when computing the discriminant or when squaring a fractional root (squaring only the numerator).

questions.solution_md:
Nuqta grafikda yotgani uchun $\log_{a} 8 = 3 \Rightarrow a^{3} = 8 \Rightarrow a = 2$.

Endi qiymatni hisoblaymiz: $f(16) = \log_{2} 16 = \log_{2} 2^{4} = 4$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Asosni topishda $a = q$ yoki $a = N/q$ deb olish; manfiy darajali argumentda ($1/a^r$) logarifm ishorasini unutish.

ru.stem_md: График функции $f(x) = \log_{a} x$ проходит через точку $(8;\ 3)$ ($a > 0$, $a \ne 1$).
ru.solution_md:
Точка лежит на графике, поэтому $\log_{a} 8 = 3 \Rightarrow a^{3} = 8 \Rightarrow a = 2$.

Теперь вычислим значение: $f(16) = \log_{2} 16 = \log_{2} 2^{4} = 4$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Берут основание $a = q$ или $a = N/q$; забывают знак логарифма для аргумента с отрицательной степенью ($1/a^r$).

kaa.solution_md:
Noqat grafikte jatqanlıqtan $\log_{a} 8 = 3 \Rightarrow a^{3} = 8 \Rightarrow a = 2$.

Endi mánisti esaplaymız: $f(16) = \log_{2} 16 = \log_{2} 2^{4} = 4$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tiykardı tabıwda $a = q$ yamasa $a = N/q$ dep alıw; teris dárejeli argumentte ($1/a^r$) logarifm belgisin umıtıw.

en.stem_md: The graph of $f(x) = \log_{a} x$ passes through the point $(8;\ 3)$ ($a > 0$, $a \ne 1$).

a.prompt_md: Find the base $a$ of the logarithm.

en.solution_md:
The point lies on the graph, so $\log_{a} 8 = 3 \Rightarrow a^{3} = 8 \Rightarrow a = 2$.

Now compute the value: $f(16) = \log_{2} 16 = \log_{2} 2^{4} = 4$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the base as $a = q$ or $a = N/q$; forgetting the sign of the logarithm for an argument with a negative power ($1/a^r$).

questions.stem_md: $f(x) = 4x - 4$ va $g(x) = 3x^{2} + 4$ funksiyalar berilgan. $g\left(f^{-1}(0)\right)$ ning qiymatini toping.
questions.solution_md:
$f^{-1}(0)$ bu $f(x) = 0$ tenglamaning yechimi: $f^{-1}(0) = x \Leftrightarrow 4x - 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1$.

Shunda $g(1) = 3\cdot 1^2 + 4 = 7$. Javob: $7$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Teskari funksiyaning qiymatini topish o'rniga f ning o'zini hisoblash (f(m) ni olish) yoki tenglamani yechishda b ning ishorasini xato qo'yish.

ru.solution_md:
Значение $f^{-1}(0)$ — это решение уравнения $f(x) = 0$: $f^{-1}(0) = x \Leftrightarrow 4x - 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1$.

Тогда $g(1) = 3\cdot 1^2 + 4 = 7$. Ответ: $7$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Вместо значения обратной функции вычисляют саму f (берут f(m)) или ошибаются в знаке b при решении уравнения.

kaa.stem_md: $f(x) = 4x - 4$ hám $g(x) = 3x^{2} + 4$ funkciyaları berilgen. $g\left(f^{-1}(0)\right)$ tiń mánisin tabıń.
kaa.solution_md:
$f^{-1}(0)$ bul $f(x) = 0$ teńlemesiniń sheshimi: $f^{-1}(0) = x \Leftrightarrow 4x - 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1$.

Sonda $g(1) = 3\cdot 1^2 + 4 = 7$. Juwap: $7$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Keri funkciyanıń mánisin tabıw ornına f tiń ózin esaplaw (f(m) di alıw) yamasa teńlemeni sheshiwde b nıń belgisin qáte qoyıw.

en.stem_md: The functions $f(x) = 4x - 4$ and $g(x) = 3x^{2} + 4$ are given. Find the value of $g\left(f^{-1}(0)\right)$.
en.solution_md:
The value $f^{-1}(0)$ is the solution of $f(x) = 0$: $f^{-1}(0) = x \Leftrightarrow 4x - 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1$.

Then $g(1) = 3\cdot 1^2 + 4 = 7$. Answer: $7$.
en.mistake_note_md: Computing f itself (taking f(m)) instead of the inverse value, or getting the sign of b wrong when solving the equation.

questions.stem_md: $f(x)=x^{3}-3x+4$ funksiyaning $[0;\,2]$ kesmadagi eng katta qiymatini toping.
questions.solution_md: $f^{\prime}(x)=3x^{2}-3=0$ dan kritik nuqtalar $x=\pm 1$. Kesma ichidagi kritik nuqtalar va chetlaridagi qiymatlar: $4$, $6$, $2$. Javob: $6$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Kesma uchlaridagi qiymatlarni tekshirmay, faqat lokal ekstremumni javob qilib olish.

ru.stem_md: Найдите наибольшее значение функции $f(x)=x^{3}-3x+4$ на отрезке $[0;\,2]$.
ru.solution_md: Из $f^{\prime}(x)=3x^{2}-3=0$ получаем критические точки $x=\pm 1$. Значения в критических точках внутри отрезка и на концах: $4$, $6$, $2$. Ответ: $6$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Не проверить значения на концах отрезка и взять только локальный экстремум.

kaa.stem_md: $f(x)=x^{3}-3x+4$ funkciyasınıń $[0;\,2]$ kesindidegi eń úlken mánisin tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: $f^{\prime}(x)=3x^{2}-3=0$ nan kritikalıq noqatlar $x=\pm 1$. Kesindi ishindegi kritikalıq noqatlardaǵı hám shetlerindegi mánisler: $4$, $6$, $2$. Juwap: $6$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Kesindi ushlarındaǵı mánislerdi teksermey, tek lokal ekstremumdı juwap etip alıw.

en.stem_md: Find the largest value of $f(x)=x^{3}-3x+4$ on the segment $[0;\,2]$.
en.solution_md: From $f^{\prime}(x)=3x^{2}-3=0$ the critical points are $x=\pm 1$. Values at the critical points inside the segment and at the endpoints: $4$, $6$, $2$. Answer: $6$.
en.mistake_note_md: Not checking the endpoints of the segment and taking only a local extremum.

questions.stem_md: Arifmetik progressiyada $a_{5}=8,\ a_{7}=10$. Progressiyaning dastlabki $14$ ta hadi yig'indisini toping.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yig'indi formulasida $n-1$ o'rniga $n$ ni qo'yish yoki $a_1$ ni noto'g'ri topish.

ru.stem_md: В арифметической прогрессии $a_{5}=8,\ a_{7}=10$. Найдите сумму первых $14$ членов прогрессии.
ru.mistake_note_md: Подставить $n$ вместо $n-1$ в формулу суммы или неверно найти $a_1$.

kaa.stem_md: Arifmetikalıq progressiyada $a_{5}=8,\ a_{7}=10$. Progressiyanıń dáslepki $14$ aǵzasınıń qosındısın tabıń.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Qosındı formulasında $n-1$ ornına $n$ di qoyıw yamasa $a_1$ di qáte tabıw.

en.stem_md: In an arithmetic progression $a_{5}=8,\ a_{7}=10$. Find the sum of the first $14$ terms.
en.mistake_note_md: Using $n$ instead of $n-1$ in the sum formula or finding $a_1$ incorrectly.

ru.solution_md: $a_2+a_9=2a_1+9d=19$, $a_5=a_1+4d=9$. Умножим второе на $2$ и вычтем: $d=19-2\cdot 9=1$, тогда $a_1=9-4\cdot 1=5$. $S_{14}=\dfrac{2\cdot 5+13\cdot 1}{2}\cdot 14=161$.

b.prompt_md: Find the sum of the first $14$ terms.

en.solution_md: $a_2+a_9=2a_1+9d=19$, $a_5=a_1+4d=9$. Multiply the second equation by $2$ and subtract: $d=19-2\cdot 9=1$, then $a_1=9-4\cdot 1=5$. $S_{14}=\dfrac{2\cdot 5+13\cdot 1}{2}\cdot 14=161$.

questions.solution_md: Umumiy had: $\binom{5}{j}\,a^{5-j}b^{j}x^{5-3j}$. Daraja $2$ bo'lishi uchun $5-3j=2$, ya'ni $j=1$. Koeffitsiyent: $\binom{5}{1}\cdot 2^{4}\cdot 2^{1}=160$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $a$ va $b$ koeffitsiyentlarini darajaga ko'tarishni unutish yoki $b$ ning ishorasini yo'qotish.

ru.solution_md: Общий член: $\binom{5}{j}\,a^{5-j}b^{j}x^{5-3j}$. Показатель равен $2$ при $5-3j=2$, то есть $j=1$. Коэффициент: $\binom{5}{1}\cdot 2^{4}\cdot 2^{1}=160$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Забыть возвести коэффициенты $a$ и $b$ в степень или потерять знак $b$.

kaa.solution_md: Ulıwma aǵza: $\binom{5}{j}\,a^{5-j}b^{j}x^{5-3j}$. Dáreje $2$ bolıwı ushın $5-3j=2$, yaǵnıy $j=1$. Koeffitsiyent: $\binom{5}{1}\cdot 2^{4}\cdot 2^{1}=160$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $a$ hám $b$ koeffitsiyentlerin dárejege kóteriwdi umıtıw yamasa $b$ nıń belgisin joǵaltıw.

en.stem_md: Find the coefficient of $x^{2}$ in the expansion of $\left(2x+\dfrac{2}{x^{2}}\right)^{5}$.
en.solution_md: General term: $\binom{5}{j}\,a^{5-j}b^{j}x^{5-3j}$. The exponent equals $2$ when $5-3j=2$, i.e. $j=1$. Coefficient: $\binom{5}{1}\cdot 2^{4}\cdot 2^{1}=160$.
en.mistake_note_md: Forgetting to raise the coefficients $a$ and $b$ to powers or losing the sign of $b$.

ru.solution_md:

Углы: $36^{\circ}$, $54^{\circ}$, $90^{\circ}$. Наименьший — $36^{\circ}$, наибольший — $90^{\circ}$.

Внешний угол вместе со смежным внутренним даёт $180^{\circ}$: $180^{\circ}-36^{\circ}=144^{\circ}$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Путают внешний угол со смежным внутренним либо делят $360^{\circ}$ (а не $180^{\circ}$) в заданном отношении.

en.stem_md: The angles of triangle $ABC$ are in the ratio $2:3:5$. Match each quantity with its value (in degrees).

items.text_md: The exterior angle at the vertex of the smallest angle

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="36,169 284,169 198.3,51" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="21.6" y="173.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="298.1" y="174" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="203" y="36.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC (angles are given by a ratio; the sketch is approximate).

en.solution_md:
The angles add up to $180^{\circ}$: $2x+3x+5x=180^{\circ}$, so $x=18^{\circ}$.

The angles are $36^{\circ}$, $54^{\circ}$, $90^{\circ}$. The smallest is $36^{\circ}$, the largest is $90^{\circ}$.

An exterior angle and the adjacent interior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$: $180^{\circ}-36^{\circ}=144^{\circ}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Confusing the exterior angle with another angle instead of the adjacent interior one, or splitting $360^{\circ}$ rather than $180^{\circ}$ in the given ratio.

questions.stem_md: $ABC$ uchburchakda $AB=8$ sm, $AC=15$ sm va $\angle BAC=60^{\circ}$. $BC$ tomonning uzunligini (sm da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="112,188 208,188 202,32" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 132 188 A 20 20 0 0 0 122 170.7" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="144" y="169.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">60°</text><text x="100.5" y="197.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="216.2" y="200.6" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="205.9" y="17.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="160" y="201" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="145.7" y="103.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: ABC uchburchak: AB = 8, AC = 15, A uchidagi burchak 60 gradus.

questions.solution_md:
Kosinuslar teoremasi: $BC^2=AB^2+AC^2-2\cdot AB\cdot AC\cdot\cos A$.

$\cos 60^{\circ}=\dfrac12$, shuning uchun $BC^2=64+225-120=169$.

$BC=\sqrt{169}=13$ sm.
questions.mistake_note_md: Pifagor teoremasini qo'llash ($BC^2=AB^2+AC^2$) yoki $\cos 120^{\circ}$ ning ishorasini adashtirish: $-\dfrac12$ bo'lgani uchun $-2ab\cos A=+ab$ bo'ladi.

Теорема косинусов: $BC^2=AB^2+AC^2-2\cdot AB\cdot AC\cdot\cos A$.

en.solution_md:
Law of cosines: $BC^2=AB^2+AC^2-2\cdot AB\cdot AC\cdot\cos A$.

$\cos 60^{\circ}=\dfrac12$, so $BC^2=64+225-120=169$.

$BC=\sqrt{169}=13$ cm.
en.mistake_note_md: Applying the Pythagorean theorem ($BC^2=AB^2+AC^2$) or mixing up the sign of $\cos 120^{\circ}$: it is $-\dfrac12$, so $-2ab\cos A=+ab$.

questions.stem_md: Koordinata tekisligida $A(1;-6)$, $B(1;0)$ va $C(9;0)$ nuqtalar berilgan. $ABC$ uchburchak uchun quyidagilarni toping.

a.hint: Javobni butun son, oddiy kasr yoki o'nli kasr (nuqta bilan) ko'rinishida yozing.

b.prompt_md: Uchburchakka ichki chizilgan aylananing radiusini toping.
b.hint: Javobni butun son, oddiy kasr yoki o'nli kasr (nuqta bilan) ko'rinishida yozing.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="80,170 80,50 240,50" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><circle cx="80" cy="170" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="80" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="240" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="66.7" y="190" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A(1;-6)</text><text x="59.2" y="34.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B(1;0)</text><text x="264.3" y="40.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C(9;0)</text></svg>
figure.alt: Koordinata tekisligidagi ABC uchburchak: A(1; -6), B(1; 0), C(9; 0).

questions.solution_md:
$B$ va $C$ nuqtalarning ordinatalari teng ($0$), shuning uchun $BC\parallel Ox$ va $BC=|9-1|=8$. $A$ nuqtadan $BC$ gacha masofa $h=|-6-0|=6$.

a) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 8\cdot 6=24$.

b) Tomonlar: $AB=\sqrt{(1-1)^2+(-6-0)^2}=6$, $AC=\sqrt{(1-9)^2+(-6-0)^2}=10$. Yarim perimetr $p=\dfrac{6+8+10}{2}=12$.

Ichki chizilgan aylana radiusi: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$ da $p$ — yarim perimetr ekanini unutib, butun perimetrni qo'yish; yoki $BC$ ga balandlikni noto'g'ri hisoblash.

ru.stem_md: На координатной плоскости заданы точки $A(1;-6)$, $B(1;0)$ и $C(9;0)$. Для треугольника $ABC$ найдите следующее.

a.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом, обыкновенной или десятичной дробью (через точку).

b.prompt_md: Найдите радиус вписанной в треугольник окружности.
b.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом, обыкновенной или десятичной дробью (через точку).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="80,170 80,50 240,50" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><circle cx="80" cy="170" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="80" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="240" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="66.7" y="190" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A(1;-6)</text><text x="59.2" y="34.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B(1;0)</text><text x="264.3" y="40.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C(9;0)</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC на координатной плоскости: A(1; -6), B(1; 0), C(9; 0).

ru.solution_md:
Ординаты точек $B$ и $C$ равны ($0$), поэтому $BC\parallel Ox$ и $BC=|9-1|=8$. Расстояние от $A$ до $BC$: $h=|-6-0|=6$.

а) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 8\cdot 6=24$.

б) Стороны: $AB=\sqrt{(1-1)^2+(-6-0)^2}=6$, $AC=\sqrt{(1-9)^2+(-6-0)^2}=10$. Полупериметр $p=\dfrac{6+8+10}{2}=12$.

Радиус вписанной окружности: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2$.
ru.mistake_note_md: В формуле $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$ подставляют весь периметр вместо полупериметра либо неверно находят высоту к $BC$.

a.hint: Juwaptı pútin san, ápiwayı bólshek yamasa onlıq bólshek (noqat penen) kórinisinde jazıń.

b.hint: Juwaptı pútin san, ápiwayı bólshek yamasa onlıq bólshek (noqat penen) kórinisinde jazıń.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="80,170 80,50 240,50" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><circle cx="80" cy="170" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="80" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="240" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="66.7" y="190" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A(1;-6)</text><text x="59.2" y="34.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B(1;0)</text><text x="264.3" y="40.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C(9;0)</text></svg>
figure.alt: Koordinata tegisligindegi ABC úshmúyeshlik: A(1; -6), B(1; 0), C(9; 0).

kaa.solution_md:
$B$ hám $C$ noqatlarınıń ordinataları teń ($0$), sonlıqtan $BC\parallel Ox$ hám $BC=|9-1|=8$. $A$ noqattan $BC$ ǵa shekemgi aralıq $h=|-6-0|=6$.

a) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 8\cdot 6=24$.

b) Táreplar: $AB=\sqrt{(1-1)^2+(-6-0)^2}=6$, $AC=\sqrt{(1-9)^2+(-6-0)^2}=10$. Yarım perimetr $p=\dfrac{6+8+10}{2}=12$.

Ishine sızılǵan sheńber radiusı: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$ da $p$ — yarım perimetr ekenin umıtıp, pútin perimetrdi qoyıw; yamasa $BC$ ǵa biyiklikti qate esaplaw.

a.prompt_md: Find the area of the triangle.
a.hint: Write the answer as an integer, a common fraction or a decimal (with a point).

b.prompt_md: Find the radius of the circle inscribed in the triangle.
b.hint: Write the answer as an integer, a common fraction or a decimal (with a point).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="80,170 80,50 240,50" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><circle cx="80" cy="170" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="80" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><circle cx="240" cy="50" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="66.7" y="190" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A(1;-6)</text><text x="59.2" y="34.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B(1;0)</text><text x="264.3" y="40.9" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C(9;0)</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC in the coordinate plane: A(1; -6), B(1; 0), C(9; 0).

en.solution_md:
The ordinates of $B$ and $C$ are equal ($0$), so $BC\parallel Ox$ and $BC=|9-1|=8$. The distance from $A$ to $BC$ is $h=|-6-0|=6$.

a) $S=\dfrac12\cdot BC\cdot h=\dfrac12\cdot 8\cdot 6=24$.

b) Sides: $AB=\sqrt{(1-1)^2+(-6-0)^2}=6$, $AC=\sqrt{(1-9)^2+(-6-0)^2}=10$. Semiperimeter $p=\dfrac{6+8+10}{2}=12$.

Inradius: $r=\dfrac{S}{p}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the whole perimeter instead of the semiperimeter in $r=\dfrac{S}{p}$, or computing the height to $BC$ incorrectly.
